title: Dosa
description: Thin, crisp fermented rice-and-lentil crepe cooked on a hot griddle — the everyday South Indian carb, served plain or with a filling.
steps: Soak the rice separately from the urad dal and fenugreek seeds, both in enough water to cover, for 4-6 hours.
Drain and grind the urad dal and fenugreek together to a smooth, fluffy batter, adding water as needed. Grind the rice separately to a slightly coarser paste.
Combine both batters, add salt, and mix well. The consistency should be like a thick pancake batter.
Cover and let the batter ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours, or overnight, until it has visibly risen and turned slightly airy.
Heat a flat griddle over medium-high heat. Pour a ladleful of batter in the centre and spread outward in a circular motion to form a thin, even circle.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook until the base turns golden and crisp, 2-3 minutes. Flip if a softer dosa is preferred, or fold and serve as is for a crisp one.
Repeat with the remaining batter, serving each dosa hot with chutney and sambar.
